note: Visual and quantitative profile comparison on Scene 02 Shoal & Cape under identical conditions.

cases.caseName: Preset A: Flat Bed Control (3-Cycle Packet)
cases.description: Flat horizontal bed (h=3.5m constant). Control experiment verifying straight planar wave propagation without refraction or depth shoaling.
Submerged smooth symmetric Gaussian mound (crest h=1.0m, deep h=3.5m, sigma=15m). Demonstrates wave crest refraction, central retardation, and downstream caustic wave convergence.

cases.caseName: Preset C: Shallow Shelf (Single Solitary Pulse)
cases.description: Shallow shelf bathymetry (deep h=3.5m, slope z=30..55m, shelf h=1.0m). Demonstrates solitary wave steepening, wavelength compression, and trailing dispersive tail evolution.
Standard Scene 02 configuration: Continuous wavemaker (f=0.15Hz, amp=0.35m) entering Shoal and Cape bathymetry.
Steep solitary wave shoaling (amp=0.60m, interval=6.0s) examining wave crest peaking, trailing oscillation, and high-frequency roughness.
